# iDiTect

> Professional .NET SDK libraries for PDF, Excel, and Word document processing, manipulation, and conversion with royalty-free licensing.

iDiTect provides comprehensive .NET SDKs (iDiTect.PDF, iDiTect.Excel, iDiTect.Word, iDiTect.Converter) for developers to programmatically create, edit, and convert Microsoft Office and PDF documents in C# applications. The site also offers extensive FAQ resources covering common development challenges in document processing, WinForms, WPF, and Python.

## Key Topics

- iDiTect.PDF - PDF manipulation library
- iDiTect.Excel - Excel processing SDK
- iDiTect.Word - Word document API
- iDiTect.Converter - Document conversion tools
- .NET SDK and C# libraries
- PDF manipulation and editing
- Excel API and spreadsheet processing
- Word API and document automation
- Document conversion and format transformation
- Office automation with .NET
- Royalty-free licensing model
- WinForms and WPF integration
- DataGridView printing solutions
- Entity Framework serialization
- EPPlus and in-memory Excel processing
